title: Show Your Work: Can Small Open Models Read SEC Filings with Evidence a Machine Can Check?
abstract: arXiv:2611.24990v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A fluent answer from a language model is not a verified one. We ask whether small open models that run on a single consumer GPU can extract numbers from SEC filings with evidence a machine can check: the page and a verbatim quote containing the number. We introduce Filing-Evidence, a benchmark of 1,000 questions over 90 recent 10-K and 10-Q filings of 45 US companies, with answer keys taken from the filers' inline XBRL tags. We evaluate ten instruct models from ten developers (7-21B parameters) on one RTX 4090 in three setups: plain, check-and-retry, and the model's own reasoning mode. Accuracy with checkable evidence ranges from 17.1% to 82.7% in the plain setup, and the best result is 84.5% (Qwen3.5-9B). An automatic checker rejects many wrong answers, but between 16 and 167 answers per 1,000 give a wrong value for an answerable question and still pass every check. translated_title: 展示你的工作：小型开源模型能否以机器可验证的证据读取SEC文件？
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.24990v1 公告类型：新 摘要：语言模型给出的流畅回答并不等于经过验证的回答。我们探究了在单张消费级GPU上运行的小型开源模型，能否以机器可验证的证据——即所在页面和包含该数字的逐字引用——从SEC（美国证券交易委员会）文件中提取数字。我们提出了Filing-Evidence基准，包含针对45家美国公司90份近期10-K和10-Q文件的1000个问题，答案标准取自申报方的内联XBRL标签。我们在一张RTX 4090上评估了来自十家开发商的十个指令模型（7-21B参数），采用三种设置：普通模式、检查重试模式以及模型自身的推理模式。在普通设置下，带有可验证证据的准确率从17.1%到82.7%不等，最佳结果为84.5%（Qwen3.5-9B）。自动检查器能够拒绝许多错误答案，但每1000个回答中仍有16到167个对可回答的问题给出了错误数值，却通过了全部检查。在普通设置下，其中57%是量级或单位错误，30%属于……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出Filing-Evidence基准，验证了小型开源模型在单张消费级GPU上能够以机器可核验的页面与逐字引用证据从SEC财报文件中提取数字，最佳模型准确率达84.5%，但每千个回答中仍有16至167个错误答案能骗过所有自动检查。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces Filing-Evidence, a benchmark testing whether small open models on a single consumer GPU can extract numbers from SEC filings with machine-checkable page and verbatim-quote evidence, showing the best model reaches 84.5% accuracy while 16-167 out of every 1,000 wrong answers still pass all automated checks.
